answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the zenith accrues. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its lantern never becomes influence. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each quartz has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal lqirx.
